open_points.subject: create_budget_schema
open_points.text: create_budget_schema: [CONFIG_REFERENCE] MUST idempotently create only the tables named by = config.persistence.budget_version_table_name and = config.persistence.section_plan_table_name on the supplied connection, with columns corresponding one-to-one to BudgetVersion and SectionPlan fields; version_id and plan_id are primary keys, the combination of version_id and section_id is unique, and nullable model fields remain nullable.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: The requirement must name imported table-name constants or a declared settings object, or IMPORTS and the contract must provide the config access needed to obtain these names.

open_points.other_text: create_budget_schema: [FORBIDDEN_ACTION] MUST NOT commit the supplied connection, roll it back or close it, MUST NOT create another repository table, and MUST NOT interpolate runtime values into SQL.
open_points.question: Either the table names must become fixed imported constants usable in fixed SQL, or the prohibition must permit the validated table-name values to be incorporated into SQL identifiers.

open_points.rule: Модель не получает значений (§15.9), поэтому адрес в note сам по себе ничего не доставляет. У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: The passage must name an imported constant or a field of a settings object whose access signature is supplied to the module; the bare config addresses cannot be the generated code's only source of the table names.

open_points.subject: create_budget_schema
open_points.text: create_budget_schema: [SCHEMA_CONSTRAINT] MUST enforce at most one BudgetVersion whose source is the manual member of = models.BudgetSource per project_id and at most one BudgetVersion whose status is the active member of = models.BudgetVersionStatus per project_id using unique partial indexes.
open_points.question: Change "manual member" to the exact declared member name "MANUAL member" or change the runtime enum declaration.

open_points.subject: SqliteBudgetRepository.get_active_budget_version
open_points.text: SqliteBudgetRepository.get_active_budget_version: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST assert open state and return the sole BudgetVersion with matching project_id whose status is the active member of = models.BudgetVersionStatus, or None; more than one matching row MUST translate as a persistence failure.
open_points.question: Change "active member" to the exact declared member name "ACTIVE member" or change the runtime enum declaration.

open_points.subject: SqliteBudgetRepository.get_manual_budget_version
open_points.text: SqliteBudgetRepository.get_manual_budget_version: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST assert open state and return the sole BudgetVersion with matching project_id whose source is the manual member of = models.BudgetSource, or None; more than one matching row MUST translate as a persistence failure.
open_points.question: Change "manual member" to the exact declared member name "MANUAL member" or change the runtime enum declaration.

open_points.subject: SqliteBudgetRepository.insert_budget_version
open_points.text: SqliteBudgetRepository.insert_budget_version: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST assert open state and insert every BudgetVersion field exactly once using parameterized SQL and canonical UUID, datetime, and enum strings; duplicate version_id, a second version of the project whose source is the manual member of = models.BudgetSource, or a second version of the project whose status is the active member of = models.BudgetVersionStatus MUST translate through translate_error of the AuditRepositoryContext.
open_points.question: Change "manual member" to the exact declared member name "MANUAL member" or change the runtime enum declaration.

open_points.subject: SqliteBudgetRepository.insert_budget_version
open_points.text: SqliteBudgetRepository.insert_budget_version: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST assert open state and insert every BudgetVersion field exactly once using parameterized SQL and canonical UUID, datetime, and enum strings; duplicate version_id, a second version of the project whose source is the manual member of = models.BudgetSource, or a second version of the project whose status is the active member of = models.BudgetVersionStatus MUST translate through translate_error of the AuditRepositoryContext.
open_points.question: Change "active member" to the exact declared member name "ACTIVE member" or change the runtime enum declaration.

open_points.subject: SqliteBudgetRepository.update_budget_versions
open_points.text: SqliteBudgetRepository.update_budget_versions: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST assert open state, treat an empty list as a no-op, require every version_id to exist, and update only status, activated_at, activated_by, and deactivated_at from each supplied BudgetVersion using parameterized SQL; version_id, project_id, source, snapshot_id, created_at, created_by_kind, and created_by_id are immutable and MUST NOT be updated, while rows whose status is not the active member of = models.BudgetVersionStatus MUST be applied before rows whose status is its active member so valid activation swaps do not transiently violate uniqueness.
open_points.question: Change both uses of "active member" to the exact declared member name "ACTIVE member" or change the runtime enum declaration.

open_points.subject: SqliteBudgetRepository.upsert_section_plan
open_points.text: SqliteBudgetRepository.upsert_section_plan: [SCHEMA_CONSTRAINT] MUST assert open state, require the version_id of the supplied plan to reference a BudgetVersion whose source is the manual member of = models.BudgetSource, and insert or replace every SectionPlan field for the matching combination of version_id and section_id; it MUST reject attempts to update an imported version.
open_points.question: Change "manual member" to the exact declared member name "MANUAL member" or change the runtime enum declaration.
